episodes.title: Not Your Average Joe
episodes.summary: Meet Joe Exotic, the gun-toting operator of an Oklahoma big cat park. He's been accused of hiring someone to murder his chief rival, Carole Baskin.

episodes.title: Cult of Personality
episodes.summary: Subjected to long hours, little (or no) pay and the whims of eccentric bosses: are big cat park employees just cogs in a web of personality cults?

episodes.title: The Secret
episodes.summary: An incident in Carole's past casts her in a suspicious light, and while she maintains her innocence, Joe is all too happy to point the finger at her.

episodes.title: Playing with Fire
episodes.summary: Joe ramps up his efforts to become an internet and TV star, but a mysterious fire and lawsuit threaten his plans — until an angel investor appears.

episodes.title: Make America Exotic Again
episodes.summary: As Joe dives into politics, he deals with turmoil and tragedy in his personal life. Meanwhile, the dynamics at the park change with the new owners.

episodes.title: The Noble Thing to Do
episodes.summary: James Garretson makes a shocking claim about Joe, leading to FBI involvement. Desperation sets in for Joe, who thinks Jeff and James have set him up.

episodes.title: Dethroned
episodes.summary: Joe faces the music in the courtroom but insists the story is far from over. Jeff's business prospects crumble. Former G.W. Zoo workers try to move on.

episodes.title: The Tiger King and I
episodes.summary: A Tiger King after show hosted by Joel McHale and featuring brand new interviews with John Reinke, Joshua Dial, John Finlay, Saff, Erik Cowie, Rick Kirkman, and Jeff and Lauren Lowe.

episodes.title: Beg Your Pardon
episodes.summary: With Joe in prison, others from the series seek to capitalize on their fame. Meanwhile, a team forms to press Donald Trump for a presidential pardon.

episodes.title: The Carole Diaries
episodes.summary: Renewed interest in Don's disappearance leads authorities, journalists and his children to investigate how, when — and even if — he was killed.

episodes.title: Bounty Hunting
episodes.summary: Don's daughters escalate their efforts to learn more about their father's fate. Carole's version of events faces further scrutiny.

episodes.title: The Lyin' King
episodes.summary: Jeff goes on the defensive when acquaintances and former associates accuse him of misdeeds. Meanwhile, Tim faces legal issues in Indiana.

episodes.title: Stark Raving Mad
episodes.summary: Tim vows to stand his ground. Jeff goes to bat for Joe, but one last stunning claim from a familiar face turns the story on its head yet again.
